In this case, we have an indeterminate form of type $\frac{\infty }{\infty },$ so applying L'Hopital's rule yields

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{3x+\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{x}} & ={lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{[3x+\sqrt{x}]^{′}}{[\sqrt{x}]^{′}} \\  & ={lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{(3+\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}})}{\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}} \\  & ={lim}_{x\to \infty }(6\sqrt{x}+1) \\  & =\infty .\end{aligned}
$$
